output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount_granted
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Sums discount_amount from marts.fct_orders for orders with status 'completed' and order_date in calendar year 2025. The status value 'completed' is assumed from the question wording since I could not inspect the distinct status values. Dates use a half-open range so the full year is included.
